title: Overcome Memory Inhibition
description: To retrieve all items: - Rotate focus: Review all parts of a list instead of sticking to the first items. - Use triggers: Write down clues to jog your memory for the forgotten parts. - Repeat evenly: Go over the list multiple times without overemphasizing certain items. Example: When revising notes, review sections evenly instead of just re-reading the first few pages.
